title: Freeze Console Beta boundary and module ownership
purpose: Freeze the next TUI architecture before implementation so the full-screen console improves UX without turning agentd into a runtime owner.
scope: Define TuiShell, OperatorSession, PanelLayout, CommandPalette, ProjectionSnapshot, ViewRenderer and TypedCommandDispatch ownership.
Document which modules may read RunStore, AuditJournal, support bundle and AOM projections.
Document which modules may dispatch typed commands into AgentCore, support bundle and AOM APIs.
Reaffirm that planner, resolver, policy and side-effect logic stay outside TUI.
Define Console Beta promotion language and non-GA boundary.
acceptance_criteria: TUI ownership is frozen as projection-controller only.
AgentCore, SecurityExecutionEngine and agent_core::ecosystem ownership is explicitly preserved.
OperatorSession is defined as UI state only and not permission authority.
Implementation tasks can reference the boundary doc before editing code.
failure_modes: Full-screen TUI design implies direct execution authority.
Operator profiles are mistaken for access-control authority.
AOM resolver logic is moved into agentd.
